name: Covert Ops - Beta
summary: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gaxim Rustfizzle sends an agent into the Venture Company’s mine. Explosives will draw the goblins away while the agent takes letters that reveal the company’s plans and help defend the Sentinels’ lands.

sections.title: Sabotage in the Depths
sections.body: After the first blows against the Venture Company’s logging at Windshear Crag, Gaxim Rustfizzle turns to the company’s supply heart. The plan follows the same pattern as before: an explosive diversion scatters goblin workers and mercenaries while an agent searches the mine for written orders and records.

sections.title: Eyes on Windshear Mine
sections.body: At the eastern edge of Windshear Crag, Windshear Mine is the Venture Company’s base beneath the mountain. Its goblins dig for rock and cut timber, keeping records of supply routes and orders from their leaders. An agent slips inside, sets Gaxim’s explosive packs, and takes the Venture Co. Letters. The blast disrupts the mine’s guard, and the letters reveal more of the company’s plans in Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Pragmatic Partnership
sections.body: Gaxim takes pleasure in clever devices and explosions, but the work also matters to the night elves. In Stonetalon, the Sentinels face the Horde as well as the companies cutting and digging through their lands. Letters from the mine give commanders such as Kaela Shadowspear information they can use to anticipate threats to the sacred woods.

faq.q: What is the goal of Covert Ops - Beta?
aliases: what do i do in covert ops beta
faq.answer: An agent enters Windshear Mine at the eastern end of Windshear Crag, sets Gaxim Rustfizzle’s explosive pack as a diversion, and takes the Venture Co. Letters about the company’s operations.
Gaxim Rustfizzle is a gnome engineer in the Stonetalon Mountains. He uses his engineering and explosives to aid the night elf Sentinels against the Venture Company’s logging and mining.
Windshear Mine lies at the eastern end of Windshear Crag, within the Venture Company’s logged lands.

faq.q: Why does Gaxim want the Venture Co. Letters?
aliases: what are the venture co letters
faq.answer: The Venture Co. Letters detail supply routes, orders from leaders, and plans for the region. They help the Alliance and the Sentinels anticipate the company’s actions and hinder its work in the forest.

faq.q: How does this mission benefit the night elves?
faq.answer: The Sentinels have too few forces to watch all of Stonetalon. Gaxim’s blasts delay the logging, and the letters give commanders such as Kaela Shadowspear useful intelligence about their foes.

Plan Alpha was Gaxim’s earlier operation at the Venture Company lumber mill south of Cragpool Lake. An agent used an explosive diversion to steal the company’s engineering plans, and Plan Beta uses the same approach at Windshear Mine.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see engineering skill and careful planning put to military use in Gaxim Rustfizzle’s explosive devices and covert work.
As a night elf, you know the Venture Company is cutting down the ancient woods. Gaxim’s operations give Sentinel commanders information to help defend the mountain.
As an engineer, you can see how Gaxim’s Covert Ops Pack uses a clever explosive diversion to open a path through guarded ground.
As an Alliance member, you can see gnomish devices aid the night elves’ defense of their lands in central Kalimdor.
